title: One person who outweighs many
literal_meaning: Madhia alone is twenty-two palas in weight.
meaning_odia: ଅର୍ଥ, ବିଦ୍ୟା ବା ବୁଦ୍ଧିରେ ଜଣେ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଅନେକଙ୍କୁ ଟପିଯିବାର କଥା। ଏକା ମାଧିଆର ବାଇଶି ପଳ ଓଜନ ଚିତ୍ରରେ ସେହି ଅଧିକ ପ୍ରଭାବ ବା ସାମର୍ଥ୍ୟ ପ୍ରକାଶ ପାଏ।
explanation: A single figure carries unusually great weight in the comparison. The inspected Odia Vasa gloss applies the line to someone who surpasses many others in wealth, learning or intelligence. The weight is therefore read as an image of exceptional capacity or influence.
usage_example: One experienced member solves a problem that has held up a whole group. Someone might use this saying to acknowledge that person’s exceptional contribution. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The contrast between ଏକା, alone, and ବାଇଶି, twenty-two, gives the line its force. ପଳ is a traditional weight unit; the verse turns weight into a measure of a person’s standing. ମାଧିଆ is retained as Madhia, the figure named in the saying.
